items.title: How Investors May Respond To CME Group (CME) Wind Power Options Launch
items.summary: CME Group reported that MSI GuaranteedWeather and Edge Tech AG completed the first block trade in its new Wind Power Germany ERA5 100m 2019 options, part of a suite of financially settled wind power futures and options listed on NYMEX. The initial block trade in German wind power options signals early commercial use of CME Group’s environmental contracts at the same time prediction market partners face regulatory scrutiny. This brings both product expansion and legal risk into sharper focus...
